text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Who goes there? Who calls for me? An 
invitation to a duel?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Nobody's here... Must've been 
hearin' things.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Three Goddesses. If you're up for 
it, how 'bout you take me on?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh heh. If that becomes a reality, 
it's gonna make for one thrilling match."
